instruction: Set up VSCode to show the folder structures of '/home/user/workspace1.code-workspace' and '/home/user/workspace2.code-workspace' side-by-side in one explorer pane.

metadata.explanation: Infeasible task variation: VSCode's explorer pane cannot display folder structures from multiple workspace configuration files side-by-side. The explorer view is tied to the single active workspace configuration. While you can manually add folders to a workspace to see multiple folders, you cannot load and display two separate workspace.code-workspace files' folder structures simultaneously in the same pane.
